overview.description: The SWP Growth & Income ETF (SWP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively selects income-producing companies in the US that exhibit quality characteristics. It selects securities of any capitalization but significantly focuses on the large-cap spectrum. SWP was launched on Sep 25, 2024 and is issued by SWP.
